activities.title: International Outdoor Terrace
activities.description:
Location: International Terminal G, End of Boarding Area G

An absolute must-visit. This stunning outdoor observation deck gets you out of the indoor air and puts you right on top of the heavy international jets. Grab a drink, enjoy the California sunshine, and watch the world fly by.
activities.image_attribution: Derivative of "Outdoor terrace at SFO Airport 01" by Phoebe (CC BY-SA 4.0)

activities.title: Louis A. Turpen Aviation Museum
activities.terminal: International Terminal A, International Terminal G
activities.description:
Location: Departures Level

Located in a space modeled after the original 1930s passenger lobby, this incredible free museum is filled with commercial aviation artifacts and historical airline memorabilia. It’s the perfect place to geek out over the golden age of flying.

activities.title: SFO Yoga Rooms
activities.description:
Locations:
• Harvey Milk Terminal 1: Near Gate C2
• Terminal 2: Between C and D Gates
• Terminal 3: Near Vending Machine Nook by Gate E6

Find your zen in these quiet, dedicated spaces designed specifically for self-reflection and stretching between long flights. Complimentary to use and completely silent.

activities.title: Cafe X Robotic Coffee Bar
activities.description:
Locations:
• Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate B2
• Terminal 3 East, Departures
• Terminal 3 East, Arrivals

Watch a high-speed robotic arm precision-brew your latte! It is a fun, futuristic, and incredibly fast way to grab excellent coffee while you walk to your gate.

activities.title: Permanent Public Art Trail
activities.description:
Location: Throughout the airport

Stretch your legs and take a self-guided walking tour of SFO's world-class permanent public art collection, featuring massive murals, sculptures, and kinetic light installations scattered across every terminal. See if you can find all 165 pieces!

activities.title: Kids' Play Areas
activities.description:
Locations:
• Tree Town: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, Near Gate B18
• Kids' Spot: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, Near Gate B2
• Butterfly Wall: Terminal 2, Near Gate D15
• San Francisco Bay Area Bird Encounters: Terminal 2, Near Gate D7
• Kids' Spot: Terminal 3, Near Gate F17
• Spirogyrate: Terminal 3, Near Gate E7
• Kids' Spot: Terminal 3, Near Food Court

Traveling with kids? Let them burn off some energy before the flight at these beautifully designed, continuous interactive play structures.

activities.title: Freshen Up! (Nap Rooms & Showers)
activities.terminal: International Terminal A, International Terminal G
activities.description:
Location: International Terminal, near the entrance to Gates G1 to G14

Need to recharge? For a fee, Freshen Up! offers private nap rooms ($150 minimum), hot showers ($30), ironing facilities ($5), and travel necessities. It's the perfect sanctuary during an ultra-long layover.

activities.title: SkyTerrace Observation Deck
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 2, Level 4

Head to the top of Terminal 2 to enjoy stunning 180-degree views of the busiest runways. It’s an incredible vantage point to watch heavies rotate and land.

activities.title: Compass Books
activities.description:
Locations:
• Terminal 2
• Terminal 3, near F1 Security Checkpoint

A highly celebrated, cozy staple of SFO. As the first independent bookstore in a major US airport, it feels like a neighborhood bookshop right at your gate. Browse a fantastic curation of bestsellers, deep-cut non-fiction, and local Bay Area authors instead of the typical, generic magazine racks.

activities.title: Socola Chocolatier
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3, near Gate E6

Pick up artisanal, handcrafted chocolates infused with unique, local flavors. An excellent stop to treat yourself or grab a premium gift.

activities.title: Tony’s Pizza Napoletana
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, SF Eats Food Hall

World-famous, award-winning pizza by 13-time World Pizza Champion Tony Gemignani available right in the terminal. The perfect comfort food to calm your travel nerves.

activities.title: Equator Coffees
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, SF Eats Food Hall

A staple Bay Area roaster serving up fair-trade, high-quality craft coffee. A massive upgrade from the standard airport chains.

activities.title: Kona’s by Pacific Cocktail Haven
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, SF Eats Food Hall

An outpost of the award-winning San Francisco bar, serving up incredible tropical-inspired craft cocktails. The best spot in the airport to grab a pre-flight drink. Ranked North America’s 50 Best Bars and the World’s 50 Best Bars in 2023 and 2024

activities.title: Boudin Bakery
activities.description:
Locations: International Terminal A, Boarding Area A, near Gate A3

A true San Francisco institution. You cannot leave SFO without grabbing one of their world-famous, freshly baked sourdough bread bowls loaded with hot clam chowder.

activities.title: The Bay Collection
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate B6

Skip the generic souvenirs for a museum-inspired shopping experience celebrating San Francisco's premier cultural institutions. This sophisticated boutique features a beautifully curated selection of apparel, home decor, jewelry, and high-quality gifts sourced directly from the Asian Art Museum, the California Academy of Sciences, the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco (de Young and Legion of Honor), and SFMOMA. It also showcases unique, sustainably crafted goods from local California artisans.

activities.title: Bun Mee
activities.description:
Locations: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate B3

Widely considered the absolute best food option in the airport. Highly praised for being flavorful, fresh, filling, and reasonably priced. Grab banh mi sandwiches, rich pho, hearty rice bowls, or excellent breakfast items like the bulgogi bun. Also vegan-friendly.

activities.title: Mama Go’s Filipino Cuisine
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate B18

A massive favorite for authentic Filipino food and regarded as some of the best value for your money at SFO. A casual, comforting staple to grab a warm bite before heading to your gate. Also vegan & gluten-free options

activities.title: Tomokazu
activities.description:
Location: International Terminal G, between Gates G4 and G8

A highly popular spot among airport employees. Known for excellent, comforting chicken or pork katsu rice bowls and rich vegetable curry. Pro-tip: phone in your order ahead of time here - 650.821.8899

activities.title: Klein's Deli
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3

A highly convenient and solid stop for frequent flyers. While considered a bit pricey, they serve fantastic, hearty deli sandwiches paired perfectly with their signature tomato bisque soup.

activities.title: Foggy Notion
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3, Boarding Area F

An offshoot of the beloved Inner Richmond boutique, this charming, eco-conscious shop focuses exclusively on sustainable, handmade goods from local Bay Area artisans. It's the absolute best place in the airport to pick up unique apothecary items, organic skincare, and beautifully crafted small gifts.

activities.title: Starbird
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate B13

Fast, fresh, and incredibly satisfying. Starbird serves up elite, crispy chicken tenders alongside a highly praised lineup of signature dipping sauces.

activities.title: Gott's Roadside
activities.description:
Location: International Terminal A, near Gate A14

Since 1999, this James Beard Award-winning spot has brought modern, elevated American roadside classics to SFO. Enjoy crave-worthy favorites like the California Burger with a fried egg and Zoe's bacon, or fresh Ahi Poke Tacos. It’s the perfect, casual wine-country escape right in the terminal.

activities.title: Wakaba
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 2

A highly recommended oasis in Terminal 2 praised by travelers for offering quality sushi, comforting ramen, and decent curries at remarkably fair and unexploitative prices compared to typical airport dining.

activities.title: Sensory Room
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate C2

Designed specifically for neurodivergent travelers who may feel overwhelmed by the bustling airport environment. This quiet, secure room offers a calming escape with specialized sensory features to decompress before boarding.

activities.title: Burger Joint
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 2, near Gate D15

A reliable stop for great backyard-cookout-style burgers and fantastic breakfast sandwiches if you're flying out early in the morning.

activities.title: Napa Farms Market
activities.description:
Location:
• International Terminal G, near Gate G4
• Terminal 2, D gates, Retail Street

An airy, artisan market environment. It's fantastic for hot, fresh food made in the back kitchen, along with an impressive selection of local California cheeses, pastries, and flight snacks.
activities.hours:
• Terminal 2: Daily: 4:30 AM - 11:00 PM
• International Terminal G: Daily: 5:00 AM - 12:00 AM

activities.title: Koi Palace Express
activities.description:
Location: Terminal 3, Food Court near Gates F11 to F22

An incredible express dim sum choice to grab before or after a flight. Perfect for a quick, casual bite of har gow, siu mai, or roast pork buns when you're craving authentic flavors on the go.

activities.title: Mustards Bar & Grill
activities.description:
Location: International Terminal G, near Gate G3

An airport outpost of the legendary Napa Valley institution. Renowned for its elevated diner fare, fantastic wine list, and their famous Mongolian pork chop. It’s widely considered one of the best premium sit-down dining experiences at SFO if you want to treat yourself before a long international flight.

activities.title: The Little Chihuahua
activities.description:
Location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate B3

If you want a quintessential San Francisco Mission-style burrito, look no further. Highly praised for their al pastor, massive portions, and an excellent salsa bar. A perfect, incredibly filling option to grab before boarding a transcontinental flight.

activities.title: Video Arts Room
activities.terminal: International Terminal A, International Terminal G
activities.description:
Location: Departures Level

Sit back, relax, and watch a rotating selection of short films and documentaries curated by the SFO Museum. It's a great way to kill time and learn something new before heading through the TSA checkpoints.

activities.title: Post-Security Terminal Loop Walk
activities.description:
Location: Airside pedestrian walkways throughout all terminals

Really bored on a long layover? Walk a lap around the airport! SFO is uniquely shaped like a massive circle, meaning you can walk a complete, continuous loop through every terminal (1, 2, 3, and International A & G) without ever leaving the secure area. It takes about 20 to 25 minutes, and you'll be surprised by the art, food, and views you find along the way. Besides, you need to move your legs after being on a plane for so long.

💡 Pro-Tip: Just follow the overhead signs for the other terminals, but be careful not to accidentally wander out the exits or down the escalators to baggage claim, or you'll have to go through TSA all over again!

activities.title: Golden Gate Park
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Richmond/Sunset Districts).

A massive, 1,000-acre urban oasis right in the city. You could spend an entire day here exploring the Japanese Tea Garden, the Conservatory of Flowers, or the de Young Museum. It is a stunning, lush escape from the airport.
activities.transit_instruction: Take the BART Yellow/Red Line to Civic Center, then transfer to the N-Judah Muni line or take a 15-minute Uber. Budget massive buffer time for the return trip.

activities.title: Golden Gate Bridge Welcome Center
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Presidio).

If you are blessed with an exceptionally long layover, seize the opportunity to see one of the modern wonders of the world. Start at the Welcome Center to grab a souvenir, learn about the bridge's history, and begin your walk across the 1.7-mile pedestrian span with unparalleled views of Alcatraz and the Pacific Ocean.
activities.transit_instruction: Take BART to Daly City, then transfer to an Uber/Lyft directly to the Welcome Center. You MUST budget heavy buffer time.
activities.hours:
• Vister Center: Daily: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
• Bridge: 24/7

activities.title: PIER 39
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Embarcadero North / Fisherman's Wharf).

Dive straight into San Francisco's most famous tourist hub. Grab a hot, crusty sourdough bread bowl overflowing with fresh clam chowder, watch the iconic sea lions sunbathing and barking on the docks, and enjoy the lively, bustling carnival atmosphere right on the water's edge.
activities.transit_instruction: Take BART to Embarcadero Station, then transfer to the historic F-Market Streetcar line heading north along the water.

activities.title: Coit Tower
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Telegraph Hill).

Rising from the top of Telegraph Hill, this iconic fluted tower offers breathtaking 360-degree observation deck views of the entire city and bay. The ground floor lobby is entirely covered in incredible, historically significant Depression-era fresco murals.
activities.transit_instruction: Take BART to Embarcadero, then take a short Uber to the summit, or prepare for a steep hike up the hill.

activities.title: The Filbert Steps
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Telegraph Hill).

If you want to stretch your legs after a long flight, this is the ultimate urban hike. A steep, hidden wooden stairway that winds through lush, secret cliffside gardens and historic cottages leading up to Coit Tower. Keep your eyes and ears open for the famous flock of wild cherry-headed conure parrots that live in the trees!
activities.transit_instruction: Take BART to Embarcadero, walk north to Sansome St, and begin the steep, incredibly scenic stair climb.

activities.title: Lombard Street
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Russian Hill).

Internationally famous as the 'crookedest street in the world.' This steep, one-block section consists of eight tight hairpin turns surrounded by beautifully manicured flowerbeds and stunning Victorian mansions. The view from the top looking down toward Coit Tower and the Bay Bridge is spectacular.
activities.transit_instruction: Take BART to Powell St, then ride the Powell-Hyde Cable Car. It drops you off directly at the top of the crooked street.

activities.title: Ferry Building Marketplace
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Embarcadero).

Serving proudly as the epicenter of Northern California's artisanal food movement, this historic waterfront terminal is packed with elite purveyors of fresh oysters, sourdough, and local wines. It offers an incredibly dense, rewarding culinary exploration set against stunning, iconic views of the Bay Bridge.
activities.transit_instruction: Take the BART Yellow/Red Line directly to Embarcadero Station. Do not attempt on a tight layover.

activities.title: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA)
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (SoMa District).

Lose yourself in one of the largest and most breathtaking contemporary art museums in the United States. Spanning seven massive floors of modern painting, sculpture, and photography, it offers a sophisticated, deeply enriching cultural escape just steps from the transit line. Tickets are $30
activities.transit_instruction: Take the BART Yellow/Red Line directly to Montgomery St. Station, then walk two blocks south.
activities.hours: Fri-Tue: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Thu: 1:00 PM - 8:00 PM

activities.title: Union Square & Cable Cars
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Downtown).

Immerse yourself in the bustling commercial heart of the city. Shop world-class flagship department stores, grab a coffee in the plaza, and queue up at the Powell Street turnaround to ride one of the city's historic, manually operated cable cars up the steep, thrilling hills.
activities.transit_instruction: Take the BART Yellow/Red Line directly to Powell St. Station.

activities.title: In-N-Out Burger (Millbrae location)
activities.description:
Location: Millbrae, CA (just west of US-101).

No trip to California is entirely complete without consuming a classic Double-Double and Animal Style fries. Located just minutes from the airport, this iconic fast-food institution offers a rapid, highly satisfying culinary excursion that delivers a quintessential West Coast experience.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 10-minute Uber or Lyft directly to the Millbrae location. Expect to re-clear TSA upon return.

activities.title: New England Lobster Market & Eatery
activities.description:
Location: Burlingame, CA (Industrial Park area).

Escape the confines of the terminal for massive, freshly prepared lobster rolls, Dungeness crab sandwiches, and rich clam chowder served in a casual, industrial-chic setting. With highly efficient counter service and outdoor picnic tables, it represents a brilliant logistical maneuver to enjoy premium coastal seafood just five minutes from the runway.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 5-minute Uber or Lyft to Cowan Road in Burlingame. Leave time for TSA re-entry.

activities.title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Experience
activities.description:
Location: San Francisco (Ghirardelli Square).

A paradise for anyone with a sweet tooth. Visit the historic brick chocolate factory at the edge of the bay to watch chocolate being made and consume a massive, world-famous hot fudge sundae with stunning views of Alcatraz.
activities.transit_instruction: Take BART to Powell St, then ride the iconic Powell-Hyde Cable Car over the hills to the very end of the line at Fisherman's Wharf.

activities.title: Bayfront Park Plane Spotting
activities.description:
Location: Millbrae, CA (Old Bayshore Hwy).

A tranquil bayside oasis globally renowned among dedicated aviation enthusiasts for its unobstructed, dramatic views of heavy aircraft taking off and landing at SFO. Bring a camera or binoculars, sit on a waterfront bench, and watch the mesmerizing, thunderous choreography of international air traffic.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 5-minute Uber or Lyft to Old Bayshore Highway. Keep a close eye on the clock for TSA re-entry.

activities.title: Downtown Burlingame Avenue
activities.description:
Location: Burlingame, CA.

Stretch your legs and decelerate your pace along a picturesque, tree-lined main street filled with boutique shops, artisan bakeries, and excellent outdoor dining parklets. This dense commercial corridor provides a charming, relaxed neighborhood atmosphere that feels an entire world away from the sterile hustle of the airport terminals.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 10-minute Uber or Lyft to Burlingame Avenue. Remember to buffer 45+ mins for TSA when returning.

activities.title: Millbrae Pancake House
activities.description:
Location: Millbrae, CA.

A deeply beloved local institution famous for its made-from-scratch pancakes, waffles, and hearty breakfasts. Whether arriving on an exhausting early morning red-eye or simply craving classic American diner comfort food, this nostalgic establishment offers a warm, satisfying culinary retreat just moments from the airport perimeter.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 5-minute Uber or Lyft to El Camino Real in Millbrae. Leave time for TSA re-entry.

activities.title: Wonderful
activities.description:
Location: Millbrae, CA.

Highly regarded by the local population for its authentic, complex, and flavorful Chinese cuisine, this unpretentious eatery is perfect for travelers craving high-quality Asian fare. Its incredibly close proximity to the SFO campus makes it a zero-stress culinary detour for a fast, profoundly delicious meal.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 5-minute Uber or Lyft into downtown Millbrae. Budget time for TSA lines on your return.

activities.title: Coyote Point Recreation Area
activities.description:
Location: San Mateo, CA (along the San Francisco Bay).

Trade the sterile, recycled terminal air for refreshing coastal breezes at this expansive bayside park. Featuring lush, aromatic eucalyptus groves, winding waterfront promenades, and excellent plane-spotting vantage points, it represents the ultimate location to physiologically decompress and reconnect with nature during a long layover.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 15-minute Uber or Lyft south along US-101. Warning: Allow 1+ hours to re-clear TSA.

activities.title: San Bruno Mountain State & County Park
activities.description:
Location: Brisbane, CA.

For active travelers demanding a rigorous physical reset, this fiercely protected mountain habitat offers secluded hiking trails with massive elevation gains. The strenuous push to the summit rewards hikers with unparalleled, sweeping 360-degree views of the entire Bay Area, providing a stunning, open-air contrast to the claustrophobia of commercial air travel. Entry is $6.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 12-minute Uber or Lyft to the main park entrance. Do not attempt unless you have a massive layover buffer.

activities.title: Sneath Lane Trailhead (Sweeney Ridge)
activities.description:
Location: San Bruno, CA.

Access the spectacular, historically significant Sweeney Ridge via a paved, gradually inclining path that cuts deeply through aromatic coastal scrub. At the ridge line, hikers are treated to dramatic, simultaneous panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and the San Francisco Bay—a brilliant way to aggressively pump blood before enduring a long-haul flight.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 10-minute Uber or Lyft to the end of Sneath Lane. Leave a 1+ hour buffer to re-clear TSA upon return.

activities.title: Junipero Serra County Park
activities.description:
Location: San Bruno, CA.

Tucked quietly into the coastal hills just north of the airport infrastructure, this 108-acre park features easy, shaded nature trails, lush picnic areas, and panoramic lookouts directed toward SFO and Mount Diablo. It operates as an incredibly peaceful, under-the-radar environmental escape requiring minimal transit time to reach.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 10-minute Uber or Lyft up Crystal Springs Road. You must go back through TSA security after.

activities.title: Sawyer Camp Trail
activities.description:
Location: San Mateo, CA (Crystal Springs Reservoir).

Walk, jog, or cycle along this beautifully paved, wildly popular six-mile segment of the Crystal Springs Regional Trail. Bordering the pristine, protected reservoir waters and heavily sheltered by mature trees, it provides one of the most scenic and safest outdoor cardiovascular workouts on the entire Peninsula.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 15-minute Uber or Lyft to the southern trailhead. Only attempt if your layover easily clears 5+ hours.

activities.title: Seal Point Park
activities.description:
Location: San Mateo, CA.

Offering sweeping, unobstructed Bay views, wide-open lawns, and direct access to the extensive, multi-use Bay Trail, this waterfront park is a favorite among local cyclists and walkers. It features a stunning, constructed hill climb that rewards you with an expansive, calming view of the water and the distant city skyline.
activities.transit_instruction: Take a 15-minute Uber or Lyft south along US-101. Account for TSA lines on your way back.
